doc.headline: CONSTRUCTIVE PARTICIPATION · HAWKISH FED / GEOPOLITICAL DISCIPLINE
doc.subhead: Remain fully model-allocated, but do not expand aggregate risk. Strong earnings and tighter credit spreads are offset by a more hawkish Fed path and renewed Iran/oil escalation into publication morning.

doc.interpretation:
Credit improved again: HY OAS fell to 2.63% on the latest official observation.
Financial stress remains below zero: STLFSI4 -0.8107 (latest published week).
NVIDIA Q2 results materially strengthened the earnings evidence set.
Friday Jackson Hole guidance raised the probability of a September hike.
Monday oil/geopolitical escalation offsets part of the week-ending improvement.
Composite slips to 62 from 63; Gamma remains negative.
doc.decisionRule: The signal mix supports full model participation with a defensive risk budget: preserve quality anchors, healthcare, industrial infrastructure and income ballast; allow NVIDIA to revert from event hold to maintain-at-target after strong results; constrain AVGO/PANW additions through their evidence gates; do not chase energy after the renewed geopolitical premium.
doc.officialPosture: 100% MODEL ALLOCATION · SELECTIVE INTERNAL ROTATION ONLY
doc.execPosture: Retain the 100.00% rules-governed Merrill executable model. The week improved on earnings, credit and volatility, but Friday's hawkish Jackson Hole message and renewed U.S.-Iran strikes into Aug. 31 argue against a net risk increase.
doc.execImplementation: Enforce MRGES-001. Berkshire Hathaway remains analytical only at 0.00% executable. Release the prior NVIDIA event hold after the Aug. 26 evidence review, but keep semiconductor/networking exposure at disciplined targets; place AVGO and PANW behind this week's earnings gates.
doc.execIncremental: Favor healthcare and quality industrials only when below approved bands. Maintain energy exposure without chasing the publication-morning oil spike.
doc.execControl: Actual account weights remain unavailable. This report publishes model guidance and monitoring bands; it does not infer drift or authorize live trades.
doc.footnote: *Latest official FRED daily observation available for DGS10 was 4.67% on Aug 27; Friday market yield moved higher after Jackson Hole.
doc.macroRates: Fed target remains 3.50-3.75%. The latest official 10-year Treasury observation was 4.67% on Aug. 27, down modestly from Aug. 21, but Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole remarks reinforced a hawkish reaction and increased September hike expectations.
doc.macroInflation: The 10-year breakeven averaged 2.32% for the week ending Aug. 28. Inflation remains the key policy constraint; renewed oil strength into Aug. 31 raises the risk of headline re-acceleration.
doc.macroCredit: High-yield OAS tightened to 2.63% on Aug. 27. STLFSI4 was -0.8107 for the week ending Aug. 21, still below zero and consistent with below-average system stress. Credit is not validating broad de-risking.
doc.macroEarnings: NVIDIA reported Q2 FY2027 revenue of $96.2B, +106% y/y, with Data Center revenue of $89.0B, +117% y/y. The result clears the prior Aug. 26 event gate, though concentration discipline remains in force.
doc.macroGeo: WTI finished Aug. 28 at $83.40 and Brent at $89.31, both down on the week. Renewed U.S.-Iran strikes over the weekend pushed Monday indications to about $86.31 WTI and $90.97 Brent, restoring an inflationary event premium.

doc.bandStandard: Current recommendation equals the MRGES executable target unless an event gate says HOLD <= TARGET. Approved monitoring bands remain 75%-125% of target, subject to the 1.00% floor and 4.00% cap. Actual weights are not available; no drift classification is asserted.
doc.hierarchy:
Selective adds: VHT, SYK, JNJ, LLY, DHR, DE, CAT, ETN, GE and PH · only when below band and after account controls.
Maintain: core anchors, NVIDIA at disciplined target after evidence review, financial infrastructure, income ballast and existing energy exposure.
Constrain: AVGO and PANW at or below target through this week's event gates; do not chase energy on the renewed geopolitical premium.
doc.matrixDisclaimer: No live trade authorization. Apply suitability, tax, liquidity, firm and supervisory controls before any account action. Missing actual weights prevents drift and order-size certification.
doc.clientBrief: The Manifest portfolio remains fully allocated under its rules-governed model, with a neutral/risk-control posture. Credit spreads tightened and NVIDIA delivered strong earnings, but the Federal Reserve reinforced its inflation-fighting stance at Jackson Hole and renewed U.S.-Iran conflict lifted oil again into publication morning. Preserve the Merrill executable model, selectively fund healthcare and quality industrials only when below approved bands, maintain NVIDIA at target after its evidence gate, and hold AVGO/PANW at or below target into this week's events.
